::: {.callout-note}
## Category Overview & Scope
컴퓨터비전 연구의 최전선인 생성형 AI, 멀티모달 파운데이션 모델 및 체화된 지능(Embodied AI)을 다룹니다.

* **Vision-Language Models (VLM):** CLIP, SigLIP, LLaVA, BLIP-2, Gemini Vision, GPT-4o Architecture
* **Diffusion & Generative Modeling:** DDPM, Latent Diffusion (Stable Diffusion), Flow Matching (Flux), Diffusion Transformers (DiT), Video Diffusion (Sora)
* **Embodied AI & Robotics:** Vision-Language-Action (VLA, RT-1/RT-2, OpenVLA), End-to-End Autonomous Driving, World Models (GAIA-1, Sora)
:::
